chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from al-Walid ibn Sabih who said:

Dawud ibn Ali said to Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him): I am not the one who killed him – that is Mualla. He said: then who killed him? He said: al-Sayrafi – who was the man in charge of his guards. He said: grant us retaliation. He said: I have. So when al-Sayrafi was taken and was about to be killed he began saying: O masses of the Muslims, they order me to kill people so I kill them for them then they kill me. al-Sayrafi was then executed.

key_terms.أَقَدْنَا مِنْهُ: Grant us retaliation (the right to execute the killer)
key_terms.السِّيرَافِيُّ: Al-Sayrafi, the commander of the guards who killed Mualla
key_terms.مُعَلًّى: Mualla ibn Khunays, a prominent companion of the Imams

ai.seo_question: Who killed Mualla ibn Khunays according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This narration from Rijal al-Kashshi confirms that al-Sayrafi, the commander of the guards, executed Mualla ibn Khunays on the orders of the Abbasid authorities, a key event in the political history of the Imams. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) granted Dawud ibn Ali the right of retaliation (qadha), illustrating the practical application of blood money and justice within the Shia community. Al-Sayrafi’s final confession highlights the political pressure on officials to eliminate prominent Shia figures to consolidate Abbasid power.

en.ammaar-muslim: 3. [3/263] Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh from Muhammad b. Isa from Ibrahim b. Abd al-Hamid from al-Walid b. Sabih who said:

Dawud b. Ali said to Abi Abdillah عليه السلام: I am not the one who killed him – that is Mualla [b. Khunays]. He [the Imam] said: then who killed him? he said: al-Sayrafi – who was the man in charge of his guards. He [the Imam] said: grant us retaliation. He [Dawud] said: I have. So when al-Sayrafi was taken and was about to be killed he began saying: O masses of the Muslims, they order me to kill people so I kill them for them then they kill me. al-Sayrafi was then executed.
